column1: # Names changed at konflux M1: the Phase-0 `k1_identity_*` benchmarks measured
# `roundtrip_identity`, which ADR-003 deleted once real parsers existed. These
# Still `uncalibrated`. Numbers taken on a WSL2 laptop are not comparable to a
# shared GitHub-hosted runner, and publishing them as if they were would be a
# cherry-picked benchmark (Appendix C). Calibrated values are recorded from a CI
# run on `main`, as a reviewed change. See ADR-006.
# What IS blocking today: the run happened, its output parses, every name here
# still exists, and every benchmark that ran is named here.
